project_info.theme: Techcombank OneU World Cup live event bar scene
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, Techcombank red, white, grass green

main_subject.detail: A staged live-event poster set inside a football stadium with Techcombank OneU branding. Large headline says 'BUNG NO CAM XUC TRAI NGHIEM MUA WORLD CUP cung Techcombank OneU'. A glowing red-and-white bar set with Techcombank diamond logo forms the centerpiece. A woman in a red shirt stands behind the bar holding up a phone showing the OneU app; a man in a white-and-red sporty outfit sits on a bar stool smiling. A prize board says '5 Trieu U-Point 01 Airpods 4'. Participation bubbles read 'Ms. Ha Kim da tham gia' and 'Mr. Tung Pham da tham gia'. A time block reads '20:00 15/07/2026'. Social icons for Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok sit below the time. Bottom-right badge says 'Da tang uu dai LOI ICH TOI UU'.
main_subject.style: Event-driven stadium lounge poster with lifestyle hosts, prize signage, and clean broadcast/live-show energy

Background is a stadium bowl under soft blue light. Surrounding elements: headline 'BUNG NO CAM XUC TRAI NGHIEM MUA WORLD CUP cung Techcombank OneU', LIVE badge, prize sign '5 Trieu U-Point 01 Airpods 4', participation bubbles for 'Ms. Ha Kim' and 'Mr. Tung Pham', time box '20:00 15/07/2026', social icons, and the bottom-right badge 'Da tang uu dai LOI ICH TOI UU'. Technical style: lifestyle event poster with photo-composite bar set and broadcast graphics, bright live-show lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve '15/07/2026' exactly. Relative to Friday, July 17, 2026, this event time is in the past and should remain unchanged. Keep the live-event/bar-set mood rather than simplifying into a generic banking poster.
